Here's the Tea

Questions, answered plainly.

If it isn't here, write to us at hello@notcoffee.com and a person will answer.

What is not coffee?

Unsweetened cold tea in a 12 fl oz can. Real tea leaves, our own brew and our own flavors: Jasmine Rose, Moroccan Mint and Earl Grey Cardamom. Zero calories, zero sugar.

Why is it called not coffee?

Because it's the cold can you reach for when the day needs a lift, made from tea instead. It is easier to say what it isn't.

Is it brewed, or made from concentrate?

Brewed from real tea leaves, never from generic concentrate. That's the whole point.

Is it sweetened?

No. Zero sugar and zero calories. Take the sugar out and the tea has to be good on its own.

How much caffeine is in a can?

[mg per can] per 12 fl oz can.

What's on the label?

Per 12 fl oz can: 0 calories, 0g fat, 20mg sodium, 0g carbohydrate, 0g sugars, 0g protein and 40mg potassium. You can see the full panel on each flavor page under "The label."

Where is it made?

Brewed and canned in the USA.

How should I drink it?

Cold. Straight from the can, or poured over ice into a good glass. Better shared.
